investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked what evidence management was seeing that North America had stabilized, how quickly Win Now actions could improve revenue trends, and whether wholesale partners were rebuilding confidence.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 Nike 的修复不是口号，而是能在北美最大市场形成可观察的领先指标。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层使用“阶段式恢复”回答，避免承诺立刻反弹，同时给出库存、产品和卖穿等可跟踪指标。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management framed the recovery as a sequence: clean up the marketplace, sharpen the sport offense, rebuild product heat, and improve wholesale partner flow. They emphasized that the company would not judge the turnaround by one quarter, but by healthier inventory, better product launches, and stronger sell-through with strategic partners.
investorQuestions.tags: ["Win Now actions","marketplace cleanup","sport offense","wholesale partners","sell-through"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how tariffs, markdowns, channel mix, and digital reset actions would affect gross margin, and when margin pressure should begin to ease.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想把 Nike 的转型成本量化进 EPS 模型，并区分短期清理和长期利润率损伤。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复先拆桥，再解释清理动作的长期必要性，能把毛利率下滑从“恶化”重新定义为“修复代价”。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management separated the gross margin bridge into external cost pressure, promotional cleanup, channel mix, and product cost actions. They emphasized that tariff pressure is real, but inventory cleanup and lower promotional reliance are necessary to restore healthier full-price selling over time.
investorQuestions.tags: ["gross margin bridge","tariff pressure","markdown cleanup","channel mix","full-price selling"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how management views China demand, local competition, and the actions needed to restore brand relevance in the market.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认中国压力是宏观消费问题，还是 Nike 在本土竞争中的品牌相关性问题。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层将问题从“市场不好”转向“本地相关性和执行”，这种答法更诚实，也给出可改善的抓手。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management acknowledged that China remains competitive and requires locally relevant product, sharper storytelling, and stronger execution across digital and retail. They positioned China as a market where Nike must earn consumer attention through sport, innovation, and local engagement rather than relying only on historical brand scale.
investorQuestions.tags: ["China marketplace","local competition","brand relevance","digital and retail","local engagement"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether Nike's upcoming innovation pipeline is strong enough to regain share in running and rebuild performance credibility against fast-growing competitors.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 Nike 是否能在 HOKA、On、Asics 等竞品强势的跑步市场重新获得技术心智。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复把“创新”落到运动员洞察、产品分层和上市执行，避免空泛谈研发。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management emphasized a renewed focus on sport, athlete insights, and performance product. They pointed to a stronger running pipeline, clearer product segmentation, and more disciplined launch execution as the foundation for rebuilding credibility.
investorQuestions.tags: ["running innovation","performance credibility","athlete insights","product segmentation","launch execution"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how management should balance Nike Direct growth with healthier wholesale relationships, and whether the digital reset would remain a drag on sales.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 Nike 此前 DTC 转向是否需要修正，以及批发回补会不会损害直营逻辑。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用“marketplace health”统一直营和批发，避免把渠道问题讲成二选一。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the goal is not to maximize direct channel sales at any cost, but to build a healthier marketplace where digital, owned stores, and wholesale each play the right role. Digital reset actions may pressure near-term revenue, but should improve traffic quality, membership engagement, pricing, and inventory health.
investorQuestions.tags: ["Nike Direct","digital reset","marketplace health","membership engagement","wholesale relationships"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how investors should think about the cadence of the turnaround, which metrics would improve first, and how much visibility management had in guidance.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想知道何时能在模型里看到拐点，以及管理层是否会继续下修预期。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复用恢复顺序管理预期，避免市场要求单季同步改善收入、毛利率和 EPS。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management framed the turnaround as sequential rather than simultaneous: first marketplace cleanup and product reset, then stronger sell-through and improved order flow, followed by revenue stabilization and margin recovery. They indicated guidance visibility depends on demand signals, inventory, and partner response.
investorQuestions.tags: ["turnaround cadence","marketplace cleanup","sell-through","order flow","guidance visibility"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether Nike can control SG&A and protect earnings while still investing behind sport, product innovation, and brand heat.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 Nike 不会在收入承压时出现费用失控，也不会因削减费用而损害长期品牌力。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把费用控制和投资聚焦结合，避免被理解为单纯削减成本或盲目加大营销。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said investment priorities would be sharper, with resources moving toward product, sport communities, athlete-led storytelling, and consumer-facing execution. They also emphasized simplifying work, improving productivity, and reducing spending that does not directly support the recovery.
investorQuestions.tags: ["SG&A discipline","invest behind sport","athlete-led storytelling","product innovation","productivity"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether Nike's direct consumer ecosystem still provides a competitive advantage after recent digital softness.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 DTC 模型是否被削弱，以及 Nike 是否会回到过度依赖批发的模式。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复承认数字渠道需要修复，但保留直营生态的战略价值，并用“quality of growth”重新定义 DTC。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the direct ecosystem remains strategically important because it provides consumer data, membership engagement, product launch control, and brand experience. However, the company will manage direct growth for quality rather than simply chasing digital volume.
investorQuestions.tags: ["consumer direct","member engagement","consumer data","launch control","quality of growth"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how management is improving inventory quality and rebuilding a healthier partner marketplace after prior over-distribution and promotional pressure.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 Nike 是否已经开始修复渠道库存，而不是继续用发货维持收入。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用“clean marketplace before new launches”的逻辑解释短期收入压力，强化长期修复必要性。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said inventory quality is a prerequisite for full-price recovery. The company is tightening buys, improving assortment discipline, working with strategic partners, and reducing excess product flow so that future product launches can land in a cleaner marketplace.
investorQuestions.tags: ["inventory quality","assortment discipline","strategic partners","excess product flow","clean marketplace"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how much of the top-line weakness was caused by product assortment and brand issues, whether new items were performing, what percentage of the assortment was new, and how management expected gross margin and clearance to evolve.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人真正想确认的是：北美问题是宏观流量波动，还是产品和品牌相关性的系统性下降；同时要把销售问题转化为毛利率和库存模型。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层先承认问题，再拆成 traffic、conversion、brand commentary、product launch 四个原因，并给出毛利率和新品渗透率数字。这个回答避免了空泛乐观，适合在承压季度稳定市场预期。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management acknowledged that the recent softness was mainly driven by traffic and, to a lesser extent, conversion. They attributed the pressure to negative brand commentary and newer product launches that underperformed expectations. Management said gross margin was expected to be about 90 basis points below last year, with Q2 clearance more pronounced, and noted that newness penetration was moving from about 23% last year toward roughly 35% over the course of the year.
investorQuestions.tags: ["product assortment and brand","traffic and conversion drop-off","negative brand commentary","gross margin 90 basis points under last year","newness penetration"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether underperforming new products in North America could become a risk for international markets, or whether international consumers were more anchored in core franchises and less sensitive to newness issues.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想判断产品问题是局部执行失误，还是会影响全球增长曲线。对估值而言，国际业务是抵消北美疲弱的重要支柱。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把问题限定在区域和组合差异上，强调国际市场的核心款和品牌渗透仍在早期。这种答法把风险边界讲清楚，而不是简单否认风险。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the international portfolio was more diversified and at an earlier stage, with a stronger mix of core franchises and regional growth. They indicated that the new product issue was more acute in North America and that international markets were still benefiting from broader brand awareness and expansion, especially in China and other growth regions.
investorQuestions.tags: ["international portfolio","core franchises","North America issue","China growth","regional diversification"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked what management had learned from new styles that missed expectations, how the design and merchandising process would change, and whether recent traffic weakness over-indexed to any specific guest cohort.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想知道管理层是否真的理解产品失误，还是只是把问题归因于宏观。这个问题也在测试商品团队的决策机制。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复把产品问题从结果拉回流程，强调设计语言、商品纪律和反馈机制。对 IR 来说，这是把短期问题转化为可执行改善路径的典型答法。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management explained that newness needed to be more than colors and minor variations; the company would focus on clearer product intent, stronger merchant discipline, and better read-and-react processes. On traffic, management framed the weakness as broader rather than tied to one narrow cohort, while still noting the impact of brand conversation and guest engagement.
investorQuestions.tags: ["product design language","new style launches","traffic by cohort","merchant discipline","read-and-react"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked when the product assortment would be good enough to drive a North America growth inflection, and how the company was balancing markdown removal against the introduction of new full-price product.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想判断北美修复的时间表，以及“少打折”是否会进一步压低销售。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层没有承诺单季立刻反弹，而是用时间序列解释：先清理折扣和库存，再用新品恢复全价需求。这种答法适合管理转型期预期。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the assortment work would take time, with newness and full-price product flowing through the year. They framed markdown reduction as part of restoring brand and margin quality, even if it creates a near-term sales headwind. The company expected improvement to build as stronger product stories and clearer newness reached the guest.
investorQuestions.tags: ["North America inflection","markdown removal","full-price selling","newness flow","brand quality"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether the 35% newness target referred to styles, colors, or SKUs, what products would be sunset to make room, how merchandising decisions were made, and how AI-related technology investment would support the business.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认新品不是简单增加复杂度，而是提升转化率和全价销售；AI 问题则是在评估资本开支是否能形成运营效率。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把“新品数量”转成“新品质量”和“商品效率”，并把 AI 从概念投资落到计划、配货和个性化等具体场景。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management clarified that newness would focus on meaningful product innovation and assortment productivity, not just more colors. They also discussed clearer ownership in merchandising, tighter SKU decisions, and technology initiatives that improve planning, allocation, personalization, and internal productivity.
investorQuestions.tags: ["35% newness","SKU discipline","merchandising organization","AI tech stack","assortment productivity"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how management was thinking about the product pipeline, brand activations, and the path to stabilizing North America demand after recent softness.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望确认北美不是单纯等宏观恢复，而是有明确产品和营销动作。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把问题从“何时恢复”转为“恢复靠哪些机制”，用产品、营销和执行三条线搭建修复框架。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management emphasized that the company was resetting its go-to-market calendar, adding more meaningful product newness, investing in brand activations, and improving the connection between community, product, and guest engagement. The response positioned the recovery as a sequence of better product flow, stronger storytelling, and more disciplined execution.
investorQuestions.tags: ["product pipeline","go-to-market calendar","brand activations","guest engagement","North America recovery"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how tariffs would flow through gross margin, what mitigation levers were available, and whether management could protect earnings while continuing to invest in the brand.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想把关税从新闻事件转成 EPS 和毛利率模型，并测试公司是否会牺牲战略投入来保利润。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复用“可管理压力 + 多重杠杆 + 不停止长期投入”的结构，既承认外部冲击，又维护长期叙事。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management discussed pricing, sourcing, vendor negotiations, product mix, and expense discipline as mitigation levers. They framed tariff pressure as meaningful but manageable, while still emphasizing the need to fund product, brand, and guest-facing initiatives that support long-term growth.
investorQuestions.tags: ["tariff impact","mitigation levers","gross margin pressure","pricing","sourcing"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked for the underlying China trend after timing benefits and negative commentary, and whether the brand momentum in China remained intact.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认中国增长是否只是低基数和节奏因素，还是具备长期质量。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把短期扰动和底层趋势分开，强调门店和社群指标，避免只用收入增速回答。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said China continued to show strong underlying momentum, supported by brand awareness, store productivity, community engagement, and demand for core products. They acknowledged temporary noise but framed China as a durable international growth engine.
investorQuestions.tags: ["China underlying trend","brand momentum","community engagement","store productivity","international growth"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how much marketing would increase, where that spending would go, and how management was thinking about unit growth and store expansion.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想知道费用上升是临时补救还是长期品牌投资，以及线下扩张是否会拖累资本效率。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把营销支出与具体品牌资产绑定，同时强调开店纪律，避免市场把投入理解为无约束费用膨胀。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said marketing would support brand heat, product stories, community events, elite athlete content, and social channels. On stores, the company maintained a disciplined approach, with some openings shifting timing and capital directed toward high-return opportunities.
investorQuestions.tags: ["marketing investment","elite athletes","social channels","unit growth","disciplined capital spending"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how management gains confidence in low double-digit HOKA growth for the full year and how to think about first-half versus second-half timing within the new multi-year framework.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 HOKA 是否已经降速，以及多年框架是否只是保守包装。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把短期节奏和底层需求拆开，并用区域结构解释长期增长来源，避免市场过度解读单季波动。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said shipment timing, including Europe logistics transitions, affected near-term cadence, but underlying trends remained positive globally. They expressed high confidence in HOKA's full-year delivery and said international should continue to grow faster than the U.S. over the multi-year period.
investorQuestions.tags: ["low double-digit growth","shipment timing","positive trends globally","international growth","multi-year framework"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how much UGG growth will come from classic winter products versus newer spring/summer/fall offerings, and whether more HOKA stores could become a growth driver through 2030.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认两个核心品牌是否都有长期延展空间，而不是分别受限于季节性和跑步专业场景。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用“UGG 四季化 + HOKA 系列平台化”的双线回答，强化组合公司不是单一爆款周期。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said UGG is increasingly building relevance beyond the classic winter season, with more spring/summer products and broader consumer occasions. For HOKA, management highlighted large franchise families, lifestyle green shoots, and a broader assortment that can support selective retail expansion over time.
investorQuestions.tags: ["12-month brand","spring-summer business","HOKA franchise families","lifestyle green shoots","retail expansion"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how to think about the low-20% operating margin framework, including gross margin versus SG&A, given strong full-price selling and freight or input-cost dynamics.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想把多年框架转化成利润率模型，并判断是否存在向上经营杠杆。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复没有把利润率目标简单最大化，而是强调毛利稳定、费用杠杆和品牌投资平衡，适合高端品牌长期叙事。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the framework assumes strong gross margins and some operating expense leverage, while still investing behind the brands. They emphasized that product pricing is based on value delivered to consumers, and that maintaining brand investment remains part of the long-term model.
investorQuestions.tags: ["low-20% operating margin","gross margin","SG&A leverage","brand investment","value delivered"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked where HOKA lifestyle stands today, how a new campaign could develop that business, and whether diversification beyond Bondi and Clifton meaningfully changes the mix.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 HOKA 的增长是否过度依赖少数大单品，以及生活方式扩展是否会稀释跑步专业性。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用“performance origin + lifestyle use case”的表达连接两个市场，避免把生活方式讲成纯时尚转向。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said HOKA still starts from performance credibility, but consumers are increasingly wearing the product for lifestyle occasions. New and updated franchises such as Mach, Speedgoat, Cielo, Gaviota, Arahi, Stinson, and Transport help broaden the platform while keeping the brand anchored in performance.
investorQuestions.tags: ["HOKA lifestyle","franchise diversification","performance credibility","Bondi and Clifton","broader platform"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether HOKA guidance was conservative despite easy comparisons, how strategic channel decisions affect quarterly growth, and what the order book says about next year.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认低指引是否代表需求放缓，还是渠道节奏和长期 marketplace 管理。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层主动把投资人注意力从季度比较转向渠道健康和长期 DTC mix，避免被短期发货节奏绑定。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said it manages both HOKA and UGG for long-term sustainable growth, not quarterly comparisons. Inventory is flowed into the channel to match demand while also setting up future DTC growth. Management described the order book as encouraging, with visibility across several quarters.
investorQuestions.tags: ["strategic channel decisions","long-term sustainable growth","inventory flow","DTC growth","order book visibility"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked what drove the positive inflection in HOKA U.S. DTC after earlier commentary that consumers preferred to shop new product in person.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 DTC 反弹是否可持续，还是只是新品上市后的短期反应。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复把 DTC 拐点拆成产品熟悉度、会员、库存和 engagement 四个驱动，增强持续性叙事。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said consumers became more familiar with updated products as the season progressed. Product improvements, membership programs, early drops, cleaner marketplace inventory, and stronger consumer engagement all supported DTC improvement.
investorQuestions.tags: ["DTC inflection","membership program","product updates","clean marketplace","consumer engagement"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked why guidance for HOKA and UGG appeared lower than earlier frameworks, whether conservatism or weather was embedded, and how management was thinking about full-year delivery.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想判断重新给出指引是风险降低，还是公司对增长曲线下修。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用环境、节奏和品牌健康解释指引，而不是把问题简化为天气或保守。这样能稳住对全年质量的理解。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said guidance reflected the current operating environment, timing, and a disciplined approach to brand management. They emphasized strong brand positioning into the holiday quarter, with HOKA still early in its global potential and UGG continuing to generate broad consumer appeal.
investorQuestions.tags: ["reinstated guidance","HOKA growth","UGG holiday","brand positioning","disciplined outlook"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how to think about U.S. and international growth after U.S. softness and very strong international growth, and whether DTC growth should improve.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认增长结构是否过度依赖海外一次性节奏，以及美国能否恢复。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复把区域增速拆成真实需求和时点因素，避免市场线性外推超高国际增速。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said international growth would remain the larger contributor, though the extreme Q1 rate reflected some timing and logistics factors. The U.S. was expected to show incremental improvement, while DTC trends would depend on product updates, store traffic, and channel timing.
investorQuestions.tags: ["international growth","U.S. improvement","timing factors","DTC trends","channel timing"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether HOKA had seen any change in rate of sale after price increases on Bondi and Clifton, and what promotional activity was assumed in the gross margin outlook.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想测试提价是否影响需求，同时判断毛利率压力是否来自品牌热度下降。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复把价格接受度和促销环境拆开，强调价值定价和成本因素，避免毛利率压力被误读为需求疲弱。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said it had not seen concerning early changes in selling rates and that HOKA pricing remains tied to product value. On promotions, management distinguished current gross margin pressure from markdown activity, emphasizing that pressure was more related to tariffs, input costs, and product cost dynamics than a broad promotional reset.
investorQuestions.tags: ["Bondi and Clifton","price increase","rate of sales","promotional activity","gross margin outlook"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how management was thinking about Q2 trends, FX, and the pace of Salomon's running and Gravel expansion in the U.S.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认高增长是否延续到下一季度，并判断 Salomon 是否能从潮流鞋扩展到更专业的跑步市场。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把实时趋势和品类扩张结合，既给出短期可见度，也强调 Salomon 的扩张不是粗放铺货，而是逐店验证。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said it was meaningfully through Q2 and continued to see strong momentum. They noted a revenue tailwind from FX at current rates. Salomon management said Sportstyle remained strong, but the company was also investing in running and Gravel with a continuous product pipeline, cautious door-by-door distribution, training, events, and sell-through support.
investorQuestions.tags: ["Q2 trends","FX tailwind","Sportstyle","running and Gravel","door-by-door"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether momentum had moderated in any region because of geopolitical uncertainty, requested real-time China color, and asked what drove Arc'teryx omni-comp acceleration.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认高端户外需求是否受宏观影响，同时把 Arc'teryx 的增长拆解为流量、转化还是库存。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用实时趋势和流量驱动解释增长质量，避免只用收入增速回答。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said momentum remained strong across regions and all three brands, with China still on track. Arc'teryx management said first-quarter trends extended into Q2, with healthy traffic-driven comps, rising brand awareness, top-of-funnel work, and community engagement supporting growth.
investorQuestions.tags: ["global momentum","China on track","Arc'teryx omni-comp","traffic-driven comps","community engagement"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether Q4 gross margin seasonality had changed structurally and whether Salomon investments explained the 2026 operating margin guide near the lower end of the long-term algorithm.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认利润率压力是否代表结构恶化，还是主动加大增长投入。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层将利润率压力解释为“高回报机会的主动投入”，并把单品牌问题升级为组合平台优势。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the company opportunistically invested behind Salomon's strong momentum in Q4. Arc'teryx had been the primary growth engine in recent years, but now the portfolio offered multiple high-return investment opportunities, especially as Salomon inflects. Management emphasized the power of the portfolio and expected Salomon margins to return to more normal growth.
investorQuestions.tags: ["Salomon investment","operating margin guide","portfolio power","high-return opportunities","growth inflection"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how Salomon's 2026 growth would break down by region, whether some regions would receive outsized SG&A investment, and how much growth would come from existing versus new distribution partners.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想评估 Salomon 高增长的区域质量，以及费用投入是否会持续压制利润率。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复用“早期美国 + 选择性分销 + 卖穿支持”解释投入合理性，避免被理解成无纪律铺货。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said Salomon's growth is broad-based across Asia, Europe, and North America, but the U.S. remains early and requires investment in stores, elevated wholesale, brand awareness, and local teams. The company emphasized that distribution expansion would be selective and supported by strong sell-through rather than indiscriminate door growth.
investorQuestions.tags: ["Salomon growth by region","SG&A investment","existing distribution","new partners","sell-through"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked for an update on Arc'teryx women's and footwear initiatives and how tariffs had changed the operating landscape.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 Arc'teryx 的长期品类扩张是否真实，同时评估关税对高端品牌定价的影响。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用具体增长率证明品类扩张，再把关税从风险转成竞争重塑机会，答法很强势。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said women's and footwear both showed healthy growth, including about 40% growth in the fourth quarter, with new women's products performing well. On tariffs, management described the impact as modest for Arc'teryx and not significant enough to change pricing or operations; they even framed it as an opportunity to take share from brands that may respond less effectively.
investorQuestions.tags: ["women's growth","footwear growth","40% growth","tariff impact","take share"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked what drove Arc'teryx acceleration in North America and how traffic, markdowns, and brand investment should be interpreted.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想判断增长是否来自全价需求和品牌热度，而不是折扣恢复。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把增长归因于品牌和门店触点，同时说明折扣口径，帮助投资人区分高质量增长和促销拉动。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said acceleration in North America reflected brand awareness investments, community, brand marketing, and store footprint expansion. Stores acted as catalysts for guest engagement and awareness. They also noted that markdown revenue had been reduced meaningfully earlier in the year and had normalized by Q3.
investorQuestions.tags: ["North America acceleration","brand awareness investments","store footprint","guest engagement","markdown revenue"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked why the Outdoor Performance segment margin guide implied a Q4 decline despite strong softgoods momentum and upside to prior guidance.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想知道利润率保守是否代表成本失控，还是高增长机会下的主动投入。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复把 margin pressure 解释成 growth investment，并强调仍有集团利润率扩张，避免被看成盈利质量恶化。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the company was deliberately investing behind growth, including Salomon footwear, brand awareness, marketing, and new stores. They framed the spending as prudent and responsible, while still delivering operating margin expansion at the group level.
investorQuestions.tags: ["Outdoor Performance margin","softgoods momentum","growth investment","brand awareness","responsible growth"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked what the next growth levers are for Salomon after its recent inflection and how to think about owned-door and wholesale-door expansion in the U.S. versus other regions.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 Salomon 能否把亚洲和欧洲的成功复制到美国这个最大 sneaker 市场。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层没有承诺快速铺开美国，而是强调小规模验证和渠道质量，体现高端户外品牌进入新市场的节奏控制。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said Salomon is on a fast-growing pattern driven by China, APAC, and EMEA, while the U.S. is still building the foundation. The company planned a small number of compact shops in New York, Chicago, and Los Angeles to validate the format, while also strengthening B2B with elevated partners.
investorQuestions.tags: ["Salomon growth levers","U.S. foundation","compact shop format","B2B partners","distribution expansion"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how Arc'teryx women's business had developed and what had improved at Salomon to drive growth above IPO-era expectations.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认两个增长引擎是否都具备品类拓展能力，而不是单一品牌单一市场贡献。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复用两个品牌分别给出明确产品和渠道证据，强化 Amer Sports 多品牌平台叙事。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said Arc'teryx women's revenue grew more than 30% in the quarter, with rising mix and strong performance from women-specific products. On Salomon, management highlighted the unique outdoor sneaker proposition, Sportstyle traction with younger and female consumers, high-performance running products, China DTC expansion, and optimized B2B partnerships in Europe.
investorQuestions.tags: ["women's revenue up over 30%","women-specific models","outdoor sneaker","Sportstyle","China DTC"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how management views the long-term demand runway, whether growth can continue in established markets, and how the company manages wholesale demand when supply is constrained.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想验证 Birkenstock 的增长不是依赖过度铺货，而是来自低渗透率、强订单和稀缺性管理。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用渗透率、全价率和订单簿三组证据回答增长空间，再用“主动不满足全部需求”强化高端品牌纪律。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said penetration remains low even in established markets, with the Americas below 5%, while the brand continues to sell at more than 90% full-price realization across channels. They emphasized a strong order book and said the company deliberately allocates product to maintain scarcity, fulfilling only a portion of wholesale demand.
investorQuestions.tags: ["market penetration below 5%","90%+ full price realization","strong order book","allocate partners","maintain scarcity"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether growth and margin are being driven by geography or channel, and how management steers product across regions and channels.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想拆解 Birkenstock 的高利润率来源，判断利润是结构性渠道优势还是一次性区域结构。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层没有简单说“某区域更赚钱”，而是强调渠道管理能力，凸显公司对增长质量的主动控制。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said channel is the more important margin driver, while geography is less relevant by itself. The company steers product very precisely between channels and geographies to balance revenue, unit consumption, resilience, and profitability.
investorQuestions.tags: ["channel drives the margin","steer the business","channel and geography","maximum resilience","precise allocation"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked why the full-year growth guide remained at 13%-15% after 18% constant-currency growth in Q1, and how margins should progress given FX, tariffs, capacity absorption, and seasonality.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想知道强劲开局是否意味着上调空间，以及外部压力是否会压低长期利润率。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用季度权重和下半年可见度解释审慎，同时给出 FX 和关税的量化桥，提升指引可信度。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said Q1 is the smallest quarter and it was prudent to keep guidance early in the year, especially because the second half has a heavier DTC mix and less visibility. They quantified heavy FX pressure in Q1 and Q2, explained tariff timing, and emphasized that adjusted EBITDA margin remains above 30% despite external headwinds.
investorQuestions.tags: ["13%-15% guidance","18% constant currency growth","FX headwind","tariff timing","30%+ adjusted EBITDA"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked about own-store economics, same-store sales, new door performance, and how quickly stores ramp to full profitability as retail becomes more important in DTC.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想把直营扩张转化为可建模的门店经济指标，同时评估 DTC 从线上转向线下是否会改善利润。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层避免过早给出不稳定的平均值，而是先解释渠道战略目的和门店生命周期。这个答法在门店基数较年轻时更稳妥。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said own retail is becoming more important by design because it creates higher-quality brand touchpoints, captures in-person demand, and showcases the full assortment including exclusives. They noted the fleet is still small and young, with only about 106 stores globally and many opened recently, so averages are not yet a useful predictive tool.
investorQuestions.tags: ["own retail","high-quality touch points","full range offering","exclusive styles","young store fleet"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked what demand elasticity is embedded in the outlook and why management is confident higher prices will continue to resonate with consumers.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认高 ASP 和全价销售是否会遇到需求天花板，尤其在消费环境不确定时。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层没有用抽象“品牌力”回答，而是用全价卖穿和订单簿验证价格接受度，并强调精细定价降低弹性风险。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management pointed to the strong order book and more than 90% full-price selling as the strongest proof points. They described pricing as mindful and precise, adjusted item by item across silhouettes and newness rather than as one broad price move.
investorQuestions.tags: ["demand elasticity","90%+ full price selling","strong order book","mindful pricing","item-by-item pricing"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how much margin improvement could flow through, how SG&A should develop, and how management balances EBITDA expansion with investments in DTC, manufacturing, logistics, and retail.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想判断 30%+ EBITDA 利润率是否还有上行空间，以及增长投入是否会稀释利润。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复把利润率管理与长期增长投资绑定，避免市场只盯短期 margin beat，同时强化“产能约束也是策略”的叙事。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said tariffs and FX are real drags, but operationally the company is improving. They emphasized that upside needs to be balanced with reinvestment for sustainable revenue growth, especially in DTC retail, manufacturing, e-commerce, and logistics. In a capacity-constrained model, product is allocated gradually to optimize margin over time.
investorQuestions.tags: ["tariff and FX drag","reinvest margin upside","DTC business","capacity constrained by design","optimize margin gradually"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked what is driving B2B growth, how to think about next year, and how closed-toe products are developing beyond Boston.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 B2B 增长不是短期渠道补货，同时检验 Birkenstock 能否从凉鞋品牌变成全年鞋履品牌。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用消费行为解释渠道增长，再用 closed-toe 数据证明品类延展。答复把渠道和产品两条线连成一个长期故事。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said in-person shopping is a key structural driver of B2B demand because consumers want to touch, feel, and experience the footbed. Closed-toe share expanded by about 400 basis points, and non-Boston silhouettes were growing at a similar rate to Boston, supporting the four-season brand thesis.
investorQuestions.tags: ["in-person shopping","B2B demand","closed-toe share","non-Boston silhouette","four-season brand"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how factory expansion is progressing and how additional supply should evolve over the next three years, given that supply appears to be the main business constraint.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想把产能限制转化为未来收入增长模型，同时确认扩产不会破坏稀缺性。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复把供给约束从“瓶颈”转成“品牌管理工具”，用质量和稀缺性为慢扩产提供合理性。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management explained that capacity expansion is a multi-year process tied to production minutes, product complexity, quality control, and planned demand. The company reiterated that it will not flood the market, because supply discipline protects scarcity, full-price realization, and brand equity.
investorQuestions.tags: ["factory expansion","production minutes","supply constraint","supply discipline","brand equity"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked what the company is doing to maintain or increase brand momentum through marketing, collaborations, communication, social media, events, and activations.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认品牌热度能否持续，以及管理层是否需要提高营销费用来支撑增长。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层将营销从费用投入转为品牌教育和功能传播，强化了与时尚营销不同的差异化品牌语言。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management described Birkenstock as a purpose-driven brand and said marketing is centered on communicating functionality, footbed purpose, and product meaning to new audiences. They emphasized education and in-person experience rather than simply spending heavily on big images or broad campaigns.
investorQuestions.tags: ["purpose-driven brand","functionality","brand education","in-person experience","brand momentum"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether U.S. demand remained healthy after recent geopolitical and macro uncertainty, and whether management's expectations for the U.S. market had changed for the rest of the year.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人真正想验证的是：美国是否已进入增长放缓或需求受损阶段，On 的高估值是否仍有最大市场支撑，以及 D2C 增长是否能抵消批发节奏变化。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层没有只回答“需求不错”，而是用认知度、客群拓展、D2C 占比、渠道例子和服装入口多维度证明增长质量。答复先稳住美国需求判断，再主动扩展到全球和多品类增长，避免问题被限定在短期宏观风险里。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the U.S. remained very strong, with brand awareness crossing 30% for the first time and stronger penetration among younger and female consumers. They highlighted that D2C growth was outpacing wholesale, D2C share had reached about 38.7%, and the company still expected D2C share to rise by 100-200 basis points annually. Management attributed the momentum to premium execution, Cloudtilt performance, Foot Locker/JD channel expansion, apparel as a new entry point, and full-price demand across e-commerce and retail stores.
investorQuestions.tags: ["awareness crossed the 30% threshold","younger audiences","skewing more female","D2C share","full price growth","premium execution"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether the company would remain committed to premium positioning after the management transition, and whether it might pursue faster sales growth by lowering prices or expanding lower-quality channels at the expense of long-term brand equity.
investorQuestions.intent: 这类问题表面上问战略，实际是在测试“估值护城河”：高毛利和高增长是否依赖稀缺性、全价销售和品牌纪律，一旦管理层换届是否会改变经营哲学。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用价值观先定调，再用增长支柱承接商业逻辑。答复没有陷入“是否降价”的防守，而是把问题升级为“公司到底要成为什么样的品牌”，从而强化高端定位的稳定性。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management stated that On was never built to become the largest company, but to become the most desirable, beautiful, sustainable, performant, and innovative brand. They emphasized that growth must serve the long-term brand vision rather than short-term scale. Management also pointed to apparel, global retail, performance innovation, lifestyle expansion, and store growth as multiple high-quality growth pillars that allow the company to grow without sacrificing premium positioning.
investorQuestions.tags: ["not pursuing growth at any cost","premium brand","most desirable","brand equity","growth trajectories","defining decade"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked why the full-year guidance appeared to imply a slower growth cadence after Q1, how management was modeling D2C and wholesale growth, and what drove the gross margin outperformance.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认两件事：第一，全年增长是否过度前置；第二，毛利率改善是一次性还是结构性。问题背后是模型中的收入节奏和长期利润率假设。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层采用“先讲收入质量，再讲利润桥”的结构。它主动承认批发增速慢于 DTC，但把原因解释为库存健康和长期创新铺垫，而不是需求不足；毛利率答复则用基点拆解增强可信度。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management explained that guidance assumed D2C would remain very strong, while wholesale would grow more slowly, leading to continued D2C share gains. The company also wanted wholesale partners to enter the 2027 innovation cycle with clean inventory. On gross margin, management broke out benefits from supply-chain measures, full-price selling, FX, and tariffs, described 64.5% gross margin as a new baseline, and noted that part of the margin upside would be reinvested into product detail, innovation, and desirability.
investorQuestions.tags: ["continued very strong growth of D2C","clean inventory levels","gross margin delta","new baseline","full price discipline","reinvesting in product"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked management to discuss 2026 regional growth expectations, especially the key drivers in North America and how wholesale partners were receiving the new innovation pipeline.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认高增长是否仍有区域和产品支撑，尤其在北美体量变大后，增长是否会自然降速。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把区域问题转化为“全球产品周期”问题，通过创新管线和跑步社群反馈证明增长不是单一区域补货。回复中同时强调 DTC、批发和产品三条线，形成完整增长闭环。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the On brand was strong in every region and that 2026 would bring the company's strongest innovation and performance product pipeline. They highlighted LightSpray, Cloudmonster, Cloudrunner, apparel, and DTC technology investment. In North America, management pointed to remaining brand-awareness and door-penetration opportunity, positive reaction from the run specialty community, and continued share gains in running.
investorQuestions.tags: ["strongest product pipeline","LightSpray","relaunching key franchises","run specialty community","winning share in running","global story"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how the company was thinking about U.S. and global wholesale door expansion, and whether growth would come from new doors or from more shelf space and category depth in existing accounts.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人关心批发增长是否靠“铺门店”推动，以及这种增长是否会稀释品牌稀缺性和全价销售。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层没有给出激进开门店承诺，而是用“门店机会 + 高端控制 + DTC 继续提升”的组合回答，既释放增长空间，又维护品牌纪律。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said there was still roughly a 50% door opportunity across major global accounts, but the company would expand in a premium, durable, long-term way. Wholesale remained an important partner, while DTC was expected to continue outgrowing wholesale and deepen the direct consumer relationship. Management also expected more apparel, same-store growth, elevated store experiences, and higher price points to improve productivity in existing doors.
investorQuestions.tags: ["50% opportunity","key accounts","premium assortment","same-store growth","DTC outgrow wholesale","elevating customer experience"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked for more detail on the 30% brand-awareness figure by region and demographic, and whether full-year gross margin should be stronger in the first half given the stronger sales growth cadence.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人实际在问两个模型变量：品牌认知提升是否还能继续转化为收入；高毛利是否只是短期汇率和销售节奏带来的偶然。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复把品牌认知从“已达到 30%”转化为“仍有 70% 空间”，把已发生的增长变成未来空间。毛利率部分则用“指引假设偏审慎”创造上行叙事。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management emphasized that awareness was rising quickly, but about 70% of potential consumers still did not know On, leaving significant long-term runway. The brand would continue to build cultural relevance through partnerships with Zendaya, Roger, Loewe, and others. On gross margin, management said the strength was fundamental to the business and should remain strong throughout the year, with Q4 usually strongest because of higher DTC mix. Guidance still embedded a relatively high tariff assumption, creating potential upside if tariffs were lower or refunds materialized.
investorQuestions.tags: ["brand awareness","cultural relevance","gross margin strength","tariff regime","no refunds embedded","upside to guidance"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked for details on apparel traction, regional acceptance, DTC versus wholesale performance, and the long-term opportunity to introduce apparel into more wholesale doors.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想验证服装是否只是小规模补充品类，还是能够成为第二增长曲线和利润率提升来源。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层先给出占比数据，再讲渠道打法，最后落到利润率。这个顺序把“产品卖得不错”升级成“商业模式更优”的投资逻辑。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said apparel and accessories reached about 8% of total business, a new record, and were on track to move quickly into double-digit share. Own stores were described as critical for showcasing the breadth and beauty of apparel, while department stores and shop-in-shops could also use apparel to tell the brand story. Management added that apparel would be more DTC-heavy, bringing both new consumers and a superior margin profile.
investorQuestions.tags: ["apparel performance","8% of total business","own stores","shop-in-shops","D2C heavy","superior margin profile"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how much of APAC's triple-digit growth came from new space versus same-store growth, and why the Q4 outlook still looked conservative.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人关心亚太高增长是否可持续，以及公司是否为了完成 Q4 增长目标而牺牲全价纪律。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层先把区域成熟度拆开，避免 APAC 被简单看成一次性开店红利；随后把 Q4 节日季定义为品牌连接，而不是折扣季，强化高端品牌纪律。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management separated the region into different market stages: Japan looked more like a mature wholesale market with careful owned retail expansion, while China and other APAC markets remained early in the journey, with strong same-store growth and disciplined new store openings. The company reiterated a global pace of 20-25 new stores per year. For Q4, management said the holiday season was not a discount-driven sales event for On, but a moment to connect consumers with the right seasonal gear; Singles Day traffic on Tmall was very strong and remained full price, while North America also continued to show momentum.
investorQuestions.tags: ["same-store growth","disciplined store openings","multi-year journey","full-price environment","Singles Day","premium way"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked why the company had confidence to raise constant-currency sales growth guidance and adjusted EBITDA margin guidance despite uncertainty around U.S. tariffs.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人真正想判断的是：关税是否会吞噬 On 的毛利率优势，以及管理层上调指引是否过于乐观。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把“关税风险”先正常化为行业长期变量，再展示公司专属缓释杠杆。答复没有回避关税，而是强调高端品牌、DTC 和供应链效率共同构成防御。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said first-half results proved that the brand had strong momentum across all regions, product categories, and channels. July was one of the strongest months in the brand's history in absolute sales, and the order book was strong. On tariffs, management noted that the industry had long paid import duties, and while new tariffs added pressure, On had several mitigation levers as a premium, fast-growing brand: higher price-point products, rising D2C mix, economies of scale, supply-chain optimization, and the U.S. price increase effective July 1. Management emphasized that it would not compromise on innovation, quality, or customer experience, which supported confidence in raising the financial outlook.
investorQuestions.tags: ["constant currency sales growth","adjusted EBITDA margin","tariff impact","premium brand","D2C mix","supply chain optimization"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked what drove the upside in the Crocs brand and whether the new products represented a broader strategic shift across Crocs and HEYDUDE.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认增长是否只是短期促销或单一新品，而是产品策略真正开始见效。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用“多鞋型、多区域、多渠道”的结构回答，把一个季度的 DTC 好转升级为战略支柱见效。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the response to new products was broad-based, including sandals, clogs, and other silhouettes, and that it was visible in international markets as well. They framed newness as part of the strategic pillars for both brands: consumer relevance, product diversification, and better DTC execution across digital, stores, TikTok, and social selling.
investorQuestions.tags: ["product newness","sandals","clogs","DTC execution","social selling"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked what tariff level remained embedded in guidance and whether retailers were changing forward-order conversations or willingness to buy inventory.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想把关税和渠道风险转成销售和毛利率模型，尤其关注批发伙伴是否开始缩单。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复没有给出过度精确的税率预测，而是强调管理框架和渠道反馈，适合不确定政策环境。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the tariff landscape remained evolving and the company was managing through a blended rate. They emphasized agility, resilience, and responsiveness, while also noting that inventory and partner conversations had not shown a broad breakdown in willingness to buy.
investorQuestions.tags: ["tariff landscape","blended rate","agile and resilient","forward order book","inventory into the channel"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether North America DTC growth could continue after the positive surprise, and whether lower gross margin was mostly tied to new products carrying lower margins.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想判断 DTC 反弹是否可持续，以及新品增长是否以牺牲毛利率为代价。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把 DTC 和毛利率分开回答：先确认需求信号，再解释利润率桥，避免“增长但低质量”的担忧扩大。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the DTC improvement was an important signal that product, marketing, and distribution actions were working. They attributed the growth to broad-based newness and better execution. On gross margin, management acknowledged mix and product factors but framed the margin outlook within tariff, supply-chain, and product-cost dynamics.
investorQuestions.tags: ["North America DTC","broad-based newness","product marketing distribution","gross margin","product mix"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how North America Crocs guidance breaks down between pricing and units, whether price changes were planned, and whether lower promotions would support ASP and margin.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认增长和利润率改善是否依赖提价，而提价在大众价位产品中可能存在需求风险。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层主动淡化 price as driver，强调产品和渠道，而不是把利润率改善全部押在价格上，降低投资人对价格弹性的担忧。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said price was not a material driver of the 2026 North America plan. Select price increases were more international and limited in North America. Promotional pullback was largely about lapping strategic decisions made in the prior year, rather than a new aggressive pricing strategy.
investorQuestions.tags: ["North America guidance","pricing versus units","promo pullback","ASP improvement","select price increases"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how Q1 gross margin could be flat despite a tariff headwind, whether Q2 would be down more, and what offsets support full-year gross margin.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想把关税影响映射到季度毛利率，并判断公司抵消能力是否真实。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用“库存流转时点 + 供应链效率”解释季度波动，避免单季毛利率被误读为趋势。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said full-year gross margin was expected to be up slightly because of supply-chain efficiency work, not because price was a major lever. They explained that tariffs flow through inventory with timing complexity across Q4, Q1, and Q2, and the company was managing offsets through operational efficiency.
investorQuestions.tags: ["gross margin offsets","tariff headwind","supply-chain efficiencies","inventory flow","price is not a big component"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether HEYDUDE cleanup actions were fully behind the company, whether wholesale partners were being added, and how Crocs sandals were performing internationally.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 HEYDUDE 是否已完成渠道修复，同时评估 Crocs 是否有非 clog 的第二增长曲线。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复将 HEYDUDE 的恢复路径限定在“先赢回现有核心伙伴”，同时用凉鞋扩展 TAM，兼顾修复和增长。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said HEYDUDE was not adding many new partners but had meaningful growth opportunity with key partners through more shelf space and broader in-store presence. On sandals, management framed the category as an important adjacent growth pillar beyond clogs, with room to expand awareness and penetration internationally.
investorQuestions.tags: ["HEYDUDE cleanup","key partners","more shoes on shelf","sandals opportunity","category expansion"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked how management planned to offset tariff pressure with pricing, especially given recent AUR strength, and how tariff headwinds would shape upcoming quarters.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认公司能否转嫁关税，以及大众价格带产品是否有提价弹性。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层用“price the market”建立定价原则，既保留提价空间，又避免承诺会把所有成本直接转嫁给消费者。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said it does not price the cost; it prices the market. Select price increases were taken in some products and markets, but the core Classic Clog in North America was not expected to see broad price increases at that stage. The company expected some tariff pressure to continue into the first half of 2026.
investorQuestions.tags: ["price the market","select price increases","Classic Clog","AUR","tariff headwind"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether North America wholesale, after several negative quarters, could stabilize over the near to medium term given improvements in DTC.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想判断批发下滑是否接近底部，以及 DTC 好转能否外溢到批发订单。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复承认渠道仍谨慎，同时用 DTC 和新品作为领先指标，避免过早承诺批发反转。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said wholesale partners were still planning cautiously and consumer traffic remained uneven, but DTC acceleration and product newness were positive signs. The company emphasized that it would manage wholesale carefully rather than force shipments into the channel.
investorQuestions.tags: ["North America wholesale","DTC acceleration","product newness","retailers planning cautiously","channel discipline"]

investorQuestions.question: The analyst asked whether the prior 10% international growth outlook remained appropriate and what FX assumptions were embedded in enterprise guidance.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认 Crocs 是否仍能通过国际市场抵消北美批发压力，并评估 FX 对收入指引的影响。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层把国际化定位为结构性转折，而不是单季增长点，同时把经营趋势和汇率影响分开。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said international remained a key strategic growth pillar and that 2026 would be the first year Crocs, Inc. revenue was slightly more international than North America. They reiterated confidence in broad-based international momentum while explaining FX as a separate modeling variable.
investorQuestions.tags: ["international growth","key strategic pillar","more international than North America","FX assumptions","broad-based momentum"]

investorQuestions.question: How will the marketplace business-model change affect direct-to-consumer, wholesale, and total revenue, and what supports confidence in North America returning to growth?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人需要把会计重分类与北美真实需求分开，并重新校准渠道增速、总收入和利润率模型。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复先列出五项会计影响，再用不变的销量和市场份额证明经营实质，随后给出北美修复的产品与区域支撑。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management described the change as revenue recognition rather than a change in consumer demand: reported direct-to-consumer revenue will be lower, wholesale revenue higher, and total reported revenue slightly lower, while units sold and market share are unchanged and operating profit improves slightly. Crocs does not expect North America growth in 2026, but expects a materially smaller decline than in 2025, supported by sandals, a more diversified clog portfolio, lifestyle products, and continued international growth.
investorQuestions.tags: ["revenue recognition","units sold","market share","operating profit","North America trajectory"]

investorQuestions.question: What supports the sharp acceleration embedded in HEYDUDE's fourth-quarter return to growth, and is it driven by wholesale or direct-to-consumer?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想确认第四季度增长不是单纯依靠低基数，并判断批发重整是否已经进入补单阶段。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复把连续改善、直营增长、批发库存重整和低基数四项因素拆开，避免用单一乐观判断解释陡峭加速。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said HEYDUDE had delivered four sequential quarters of improvement, with direct-to-consumer growth across marketplaces, its own website, and new stores. Wholesale was still absorbing a channel reset designed to improve the amount and composition of partner inventory and accelerate turns. The fourth-quarter step-up reflects expected growth in both channels and a weak comparison created by last year's reset actions.
investorQuestions.tags: ["sequential improvement","wholesale reset","inventory turns","both channels","weak compare"]

investorQuestions.question: How much did sandals contribute to the second-quarter upside, and how large can the category become over the next one to three years?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想判断凉鞋是季节性亮点还是能够降低核心洞洞鞋集中度的第二增长曲线。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复先给当年业务规模，再用市场容量、复购周期、制造适配和竞争格局四个结构因素支撑多年空间。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said sandals were a strong contributor to the beat but not the only source of upside. The global sandal business is expected to reach about $500 million this year, placing Crocs among the larger global players. Management sees a multi-year growth path because the global category exceeds $30 billion, refreshes annually, fits molded manufacturing capabilities, and remains fragmented.
investorQuestions.tags: ["strong contributor","$500 million","$30 billion category","annual refresh","multi-year growth path"]

investorQuestions.question: How do HOKA's new franchises support double-digit growth beyond this year, and why are high full-price sell-through and a clean marketplace so important to gross margin?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人同时验证新品矩阵能否延长增长周期，以及高毛利是否来自可持续的全价需求而非一次性结构因素。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复先给新品补单证据，再把货盘分层与渠道扩张连接，最后用毛利桥量化全价销售和清仓管理的贡献。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said Speedgoat 7, Clifton 11, and Clifton Pro were performing well, with reorders and some Spring-Summer 2027 order top-ups already visible. A broader assortment would allow greater channel segmentation. Management also said tight inventory and a pull model support full-price selling; better closeout management added about 60 basis points, while full-price selling plus channel and brand mix contributed about 110 basis points to the first-quarter gross-margin bridge.
investorQuestions.tags: ["broader assortment","pull model","full-price selling","closeout management","gross-margin bridge"]

investorQuestions.question: How is HOKA positioned as competition increases, and how would Deckers use any tariff refunds received after sharing proceeds with vendors?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望区分竞争加剧下的真实份额表现，并测试潜在关税退款是否会改变定价、成本和资本配置。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复把已发生的竞争数据、尚未确认的退款和前瞻关税假设分开，避免把不确定收益提前计入指引。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said HOKA continued to maintain or gain share in performance running and trail, including share gains above $120 price points. It had not recognized any tariff refund and expected any recovery to arrive over time rather than as one lump sum. Funds would first be shared with partners that bore part of the cost and would also be subject to tax; remaining proceeds could support growth or shareholder returns. The forward tariff assumption was raised from 10% to 12.5%.
investorQuestions.tags: ["share above $120","tariff refunds","partner sharing","growth investment","12.5% assumption"]

investorQuestions.question: How much of the first-quarter gross-margin benefit from lower closeouts should carry forward, and when will the higher tariff assumption affect results?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人想把一次性清仓收益从全年毛利率中剔除，并确定关税成本进入损益表的季度节奏。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复明确阶段性收益不可线性外推，同时用库存到货和销售时点解释关税传导，但不提供未经确认的精确数字。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the closeout benefit was unusually concentrated in the first quarter and expected the rest of the year to look more like prior years, with no significant change assumed in promotional cadence. The higher 12.5% tariff assumption would have some impact in the third quarter and a larger full-quarter impact in the fourth quarter as newer inventory sells through; management did not quantify the basis-point or EPS effect.
investorQuestions.tags: ["closeout benefit","promotional cadence","tariff timing","Q3 impact","full Q4 basis"]

investorQuestions.question: Can you explain the divergence between the strength in your own channels and the softer sell-out in wholesale, and how long the wholesale pressure may last?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望判断渠道分化是品牌需求问题还是批发渠道管理问题，并评估批发恢复的时间框架。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 先拆分自有渠道与批发渠道的需求来源，再说明批发调整的主动性、持续时间和恢复触发因素。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management attributed the divergence mainly to a promotional Americas wholesale environment. Own channels were supported by loyal customers and new cohorts, while wholesale required deliberate sell-in management. Management viewed the pressure as transitory and tied the recovery path to upcoming innovation and healthier channel inventory.
investorQuestions.tags: ["channel divergence","new cohorts","deliberate sell-in management","transitory pressure","healthier channel inventory"]

investorQuestions.question: What are the main drivers behind the increase in gross margin guidance, and are there any markdown or one-off assumptions embedded in it?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望区分毛利改善来自可持续经营结构，还是来自一次性收益、降价减少或其他短期因素。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 先排除一次性因素，再明确渠道结构、定价执行和成本假设各自是否发生变化。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the margin trajectory was clean with no significant one-offs. The main driver of the uplift was a favorable DTC mix, while pricing, full-price execution, and FOB assumptions remained consistent with the prior outlook.
investorQuestions.tags: ["clean margin trajectory","no significant one-offs","favorable DTC mix","full-price execution","FOB assumptions"]

investorQuestions.question: Should the change in full-year revenue guidance be attributed entirely to a lower wholesale outlook, while the DTC growth outlook remains intact?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望把收入指引变化拆分为渠道因素，判断批发调整是否会抵消直营渠道的增长。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 把收入指引拆成直营和批发两条路径，并说明门店开设对直营增长的补充作用。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said the revised top-line guidance was largely linked to deliberate wholesale actions. DTC momentum remained strong, with additional store openings expected in the second half, so the business was still confident in the DTC growth trajectory.
investorQuestions.tags: ["revised top-line guidance","wholesale actions","DTC growth trajectory","store openings","second half"]

investorQuestions.question: What explains the performance gap between the Americas and EMEA, and which elements of the EMEA playbook can be replicated elsewhere?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望判断区域差异是消费者需求差异，还是渠道结构和执行方式差异。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 先给出区域结果，再把可复制因素拆成渠道质量、门店集群和品类结构，而不是简单比较地区增速。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management pointed to earlier channel actions in EMEA, including reducing distribution and protecting price integrity. It also highlighted a stronger store cluster and selective openings in Germany, Stockholm, and Copenhagen, while describing the Americas issue as more specific to everyday running wholesale.
investorQuestions.tags: ["protecting price integrity","reducing distribution","store cluster","selective openings","everyday running wholesale"]

investorQuestions.question: Is there price resistance in everyday running, and how does that affect the pricing strategy across entry-level and higher-end products?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望判断日常产品放缓是否会迫使品牌降价，以及高端产品能否继续支撑价格结构。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 把价格问题转化为价格梯度问题，分别说明入门、高端和技术创新产品的价格层级。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said lowering prices was not part of the playbook. Instead, it planned to open up the aperture of the pricing range, keeping an entry level around $160 while seeing attractive demand at $210-$250 and in products reaching toward $300.
investorQuestions.tags: ["price resistance","open up the aperture","entry level","$210-$250","pricing range"]

investorQuestions.question: What is driving the continued top-line momentum into Q3, and why is there not more top- and bottom-line upside?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望判断强劲上半年是否会继续转化为下半年收入和利润增长。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 先给出收入指引，再解释比较基数、利润率传导和再投资对利润端的影响。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management maintained Q3 growth guidance at 18%-20% and full-year growth at approximately 24%. The answer emphasized a higher comparison base, continued momentum, more than 100 basis points of margin expansion at the guidance midpoint, and continued investment in Salomon, Arc’teryx, and Tennis 360.
investorQuestions.tags: ["higher comparison base","margin expansion","responsible guidance"]

investorQuestions.question: How many Salomon doors are currently in Foot Locker and JD Sports, and how large is the opportunity?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望判断批发扩张是否会稀释品牌定位，还是能够以高质量门店为筛选条件扩大覆盖。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 把门店数量问题转化为位置质量、需求验证和品牌控制力的回答。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management described a demand-led and epicenter-based approach rather than a door-count race. The rollout starts with selected locations, evaluates pre-orders, sell-through and reorders, and prioritizes quality over quantity.
investorQuestions.tags: ["numeric distribution","pre-orders","sell-through"]

investorQuestions.question: Why should Ball and Racket growth normalize after the 24% Q2 increase?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望区分一次性新品和批发出货带来的加速，还是业务基础发生了永久变化。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 明确列出加速因素，再主动说明这些因素为何不能按同样速度持续。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management attributed the quarter to two major racket launches, Dick’s door expansion, a revised go-to-market approach and stronger wholesale offerings. The updated guidance reflects a more sustainable second-half rate rather than the launch- and sell-in-led Q2 pace.
investorQuestions.tags: ["go-to-market strategy","product launches","sell-in"]

investorQuestions.question: What are the main categories of growth investment in the second half?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望判断费用上升是短期投放，还是能够形成长期能力和增长回报。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 按人才、营销、门店和数字能力拆解投入，并同时给出利润率纪律。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management pointed to brand and capability investment, including talent, marketing, premium owned stores and IT and digital platforms. The framing linked spending to the long-term value creation potential of the three growth engines while preserving operating-margin expansion.
investorQuestions.tags: ["long-duration growth","premium owned stores","IT and digital platforms"]

investorQuestions.question: How should investors think about Europe growth and the one-time tariff refund in the margin outlook?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望拆分一次性退款、真实经营改善和两年累计利润率表现。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 先承认一次性收益，再用两年累计口径恢复可比性。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management described Europe as challenging but still open to focused growth in running and modern outdoor sneakers. On margins, the CFO acknowledged that the refund adds 80 basis points in the current year, while the two-year view includes the prior-year tariff absorption and provides a cleaner comparison.
investorQuestions.tags: ["net tariff refund","underlying gross margin expansion","two-year picture"]

investorQuestions.question: How quickly can the company adjust its cost structure if the revenue trajectory does not improve?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望判断收入承压时经营杠杆风险能否通过结构性降本得到控制。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 先列出现有行动，再明确长期投入保护边界，并避免在尚未完成评估前承诺具体节省金额。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said active cost workstreams already cover supply chain, procurement, technology and discretionary spending. The company is taking a deeper look at right-sizing the cost base while protecting product and brand investments needed for the long-term recovery.
investorQuestions.tags: ["right-size the cost base","discretionary expense","protect long-term investments"]

investorQuestions.question: What caused the sequential softening in China and international markets, and why could Q3 be the trough?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望区分宏观、品牌和产品因素，并验证低点判断是否已有最新数据支持。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 把问题来源拆分为品牌、平台活动和新品表现，再用本季度迄今趋势及具体行动说明改善路径。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management attributed China weakness primarily to brand noise and a softer Tmall 618 event rather than a new macro shock. Quarter-to-date trends supported the second-half view, while store openings, Super Brand Day and World Mental Health Day activations were intended to rebuild brand consideration and traffic.
investorQuestions.tags: ["brand noise","quarter to date trend","restore brand consideration"]

investorQuestions.question: How is management changing the store fleet, SKU density and guest experience?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望判断开店资本是否收紧，以及门店体验改善能否在不增加库存复杂度的情况下提升转化率。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 把门店数量、点位类型和店内运营措施分开说明，并用已验证店效降低扩张风险。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management said every store deal is being scrutinized. About half of North American openings are conversions of productive pop-ups, while the balance supports strategic presence and key-market density. Store work includes a 15% SKU reduction, activity-led merchandising, localized assortments and new fixtures.
investorQuestions.tags: ["pop-up conversions","key market saturation","SKU density"]

investorQuestions.question: What are consumers asking for, and how is the product-development process changing?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望确认问题是否已经进入产品开发源头，而不仅是通过营销和门店调整处理现有库存。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 先引用消费者反馈，再说明流程、追单和快速设计三项能力变化，形成从洞察到供给的闭环。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Consumer research pointed to differentiated innovation and community engagement. Management said it is embedding this feedback into the action plan, reducing go-to-market lead times, increasing chase volume by about 20%, and using fast-track design to move products from design to market faster.
investorQuestions.tags: ["consumer research","go-to-market lead times","fast-track design"]

investorQuestions.question: Why does Q4 carry less operating-margin pressure even though revenue trends remain weak?
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望把第四季度利润率改善拆分为收入基数、关税、降价和费用节奏，而不是接受笼统的季节性解释。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 按毛利率和费用率分层桥接，并明确哪些因素具有持续性、哪些只是季度节奏。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Management expects a higher Q4 revenue base to reduce fixed-cost deleverage, more tariff mitigation benefits to flow through, and markdown pressure to become roughly flat. Expense deleverage remains, but should be materially lower than in Q3.
investorQuestions.tags: ["fixed cost deleverage","tariff mitigation","flat markdowns"]

investorQuestions.question: Thanks. Hey, guys. Good afternoon, Dave. Welcome. Looking forward to working with you. Elliott, any way to frame for us how large performance for Sportswear and Jordan Brand are in the U.S.? I am just trying to align the positive and negative comments with the fact that North America still grew revenues, and if I am looking at it correctly, I think saw first regional positive inflection in EBIT margin and dollars. So that would be helpful just in terms of sizing. Dave, just maybe higher level, curious if you can speak to your confidence in these numbers and your thoughts on how much you have been able to learn and touch in the short time you have been with the company. Thanks, guys.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人希望拆分北美增长中性能品类的贡献，并验证新任 CFO 指引的可信度。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 管理层先用运动品类的广泛增长证明战略有效，再说明指引经过自下而上的业务与财务计划复核。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Simeon, thank you. It is good to hear from you. Let me start first with performance. I am going to start bigger picture. The sport offense is in fact working and you can see it as our performance business continues to grow. It is a proof point. We believe that when you really get sharp on a distinct consumer segment, that is when we win. Performance delivered broad-based growth in Q1 across all key sports. We grew high single digits in Q1, performance did overall. That was driven by Football, running, training, Basketball, tennis, and golf all contributed to performance growth. So it was across the board growth there. Q1 performance, and we said this in the remarks, growth. The Q1 performance growth was on top of the performance growing mid single digits in FY 2026 to $16 billion. Simeon, what I would say is innovation is clearly driving that growth. I will not go through every one of them, but in running, training, golf, you go through it, innovation is what is driving the performance business. It is also not just about product. It is about how we line up what we call our sport offense, not just the sport, but how we execute at the country level, across product, across marketing, and across the marketplace. You can see that what we did in the World Cup. I was really proud of the work that the teams did there, here in the U.S. and around the world. The Caitlin launch today has been incredibly successful. The Nike Hybrid launch that we did at the HYROX World Championships in Stockholm, those are proof points. When we get performance, innovation, product, and the moment all lined up, we have great success there. As it relates to North America, North America did grow 2%, as we said, and it was driven by performance, led by running, Global Football, and Basketball. Those were the drivers there. Overall, excited about the direction that we are headed from a performance perspective. The last thing I will say about North America, we are seeing good sell-through across all channels, in North America specifically, whether it is sporting goods at a Dick's, an Academy, a SCHEELS, Athletic Specialty, JD, Foot Locker, performance product is selling, and then also at our specialty accounts. Overall, we are pleased with the sell-through of performance product in North America. Simeon, Dave here. Really look forward to working with you. Maybe just a couple of comments on guidance. First and foremost, you should understand that we have really performed over the past several weeks a bottoms-up comprehensive business plan review and a financial plan review, taking in consideration all the realities that we are seeing within our business, across all the dimensions of our business, and importantly, the risk and opportunities and the actions that were taken to manage this business and returning it to health over the long term. Obviously, I gave a range from an earnings perspective, and that just shows that we have pressure tested a series of continued trends across the business and feel comfortable that this range reflects our best assessment of where this business stands today and the outlook. I sit here today feeling very confident. The teams are focused against this. These financial measures are pushed into the business and everybody is accountable for delivering against these results. This is our best estimate. I feel good about where we stand and we are focused against delivering, not only this year, but the years ahead of us.
investorQuestions.tags: ["broad-based growth","bottoms-up review","pressure tested"]

investorQuestions.question: Good afternoon, and thank you for taking our question. Elliott, Dave, I was hoping you could provide better context on the magnitude and cadence of pressure that you expect in Greater China relative to the 26% decline observed in 1Q. Are there additional strategic actions that you think are still necessary to be taken on top of what's already been taken to improve the health of the China business beyond the reset of Nike Digital? Thank you.
investorQuestions.intent: 投资人要求量化中国业务继续下滑的幅度和节奏，并判断数字渠道清理之外还有哪些修复动作。
investorQuestions.replyFramework: 答复承认中国仍将进一步承压，再按数字渠道、实体门店和本地产品三条路径说明长期修复。
investorQuestions.exampleAnswer: Thanks, Brooke. We continue to execute a marketplace reset in China, and you saw that reflected in the numbers this quarter. The teams, and we here working with the teams on the ground, are focused on becoming a more premium and culturally relevant brand. I'll start first, as I always do on this question, is China does remain an incredibly important marketplace. This year marks our 45th year of doing business in China, and we remain committed to serving the Chinese consumers through sport. We know, Brooke, when we lead with sport, that's when we win. I could point to running this quarter. It continues to grow. We've lined up in China, not only the innovative product, local experiences, which are critically important in China. Nike After Dark Tour this quarter, we had almost 4,000 runners register, selling out in the first day. We are driving double digit growth, and it's our sixth quarter of growth in running. So when we lead with sport and line up the experience in marketing, it does work. We are aggressively cleaning up the marketplace, at the same time, elevating the consumer experience. The digital marketplace, as you stated, we have taken some actions. It was too broad, it wasn't differentiated, and it had become promotional. So we did eliminate some online distribution that was unprofitable and brand dilutive. We're anchoring, as we said in our prepared remarks, around some fewer flagships. At the same time, it's not just about digital. We have to be elevating our physical retail, and we are investing with our partners in their must win doors to create more, I would say, consistent and elevated experiences, because we know when we do that, we have had some great successes at our House of Innovation flagship. We are driving growth there. The last component of this is about being more local. We will continue to invest in product creation teams on the ground in China and working on future seasons. Our first collection coming out of China, made for China, will launch in October. It will be a brick and mortar only launch purposely. Then we will continue to deliver products over time, products and assortments that are locally designed, developed, and even manufactured in China. We are excited about what the team is doing in China. I am confident in Cathy and her team. It is just going to take us time resetting the marketplace, and we will continue to see pressure on revenue and profitability in the near term, but again, confident in Cathy and the team. Hey, Brooke, this is Dave. Just real quickly, as Elliott said, we have multiple efforts underway in China to improve the performance of the marketplace and improve our performance within the marketplace. But from a specific guidance perspective, the guidance range that I just provided to you assumes that China actually gets worse from a revenue perspective for the balance of this year. That is because of some of the actions we are taking today to make sure that we return this business to health in the long term. I think that is what you should expect from that business for the balance of fiscal 2027.
investorQuestions.tags: ["marketplace reset","brand dilutive","multiple seasons"]

investorQuestions.question: Great. Thank you so much. My question is, on 2Q, I did not think I heard full second quarter guidance other than the comment about the 400 basis point headwind. Can you give us a little bit of help on how you are thinking about revenues for Q2? Then maybe on gross margin as well.
